doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Kenton's five-trombone section and Pete Rugolo

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And Shelly Manne was on the group. Who were your section mates at the time, do you remember?
That was Bart Varsalona, Milt Bernhart, Harry Betts, Harry Forbes and me. Five bones.
Wow. That’s a lot of people.
Well Pete Rugulo was writing most of the stuff and he wrote great.
Yeah. I think that’s one of his things.
Very knowledgeable about the horns and how to write for them and all that. He’s still writing.
